question: Which author wrote ‘I came form Des Moines. Somebody had to.’ in their book ‘The Lost Continent’?

greedy_answer: The author who wrote 'I came from Des Moines. I was thoroughly middle class, my father was an insurance salesman, my mother was a homemaker, I was a P.E. major in college, I played on the golf team, I was the debate team captain and I was elected to local office after college;
